tour_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_low.text: *You run into Seoyeon at the end of the hall. She adjusts her bag strap and steps half a pace aside.* Let's look around separately today. I still have things to finish.

tour_yuna_low.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_low.text: *The annex door is locked. A short message from Yuna arrives a moment later.* I want to be alone today. *I turn back from the annex and head for the hallway.*

tour_dain_low.name: Dain
tour_dain_low.text: *You meet Dain outside the gym. Holding a ball, she turns back toward the court.* I need to practice today. See you later.

tour_seo_1.name: {name}
tour_seo_1.text: *We stand side by side in front of the school gate. The very spot where Seoyeon was waiting on Day 1.*

tour_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_2.text: This is where we first met.

tour_seo_3.name: {name}
tour_seo_3.text: When we first met, I was so nervous I hardly knew what to say.

tour_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_4.text: Were you? You still remembered to say hello every time. I noticed you from the start.

tour_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_6.text: You might have misheard because of the wind.

tour_seo_8.name: {name}
tour_seo_8.text: *Seoyeon takes a small metal keychain from an inner pocket of her bag. It is shaped like the rooftop key, but has no grooves.*

tour_seo_10.name: {name}
tour_seo_10.text: The rooftop key... no, it isn't.

tour_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_11.text: It's a student council souvenir. I have to return the real key today.

tour_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_12.text: *She hands me the keychain. When our hands brush, Seoyeon readjusts the strap of her bag.*

tour_seo_13.name: {name}
tour_seo_13.text: Then how do we get onto the roof from now on?

tour_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_14.text: Ask me. We can borrow the real key and open it properly together.

tour_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_freetalk.text: *After our tour, we climb to the roof. Seoyeon rests a hand on the railing.* So even on festival day, we end up having lunch here.

tour_seo_end.name: {name}
tour_seo_end.text: *I slip Seoyeon's keychain into my pocket. The real rooftop key knocks once more inside her bag.*

tour_yuna_1.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1.text: *In the library annex, afternoon light through the window falls across one side of the old sofa. It smells as dusty as it did the first time I came in.*

tour_yuna_1b.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1b.text: *In the library annex, afternoon light through the window falls across the old sofa where Yuna and I used to read.*

tour_yuna_2.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_2.text: *She sits on the sofa. She leaves the seat beside her empty. A spot where no dust has settled.*

tour_yuna_3.name: {name}
tour_yuna_3.text: When I come here, the outside sounds seem a little distant.

tour_yuna_6.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_6.text: *She takes a new notebook from her bag. The margins show where she has revised and copied over her earlier draft.*

tour_yuna_8.name: {name}
tour_yuna_8.text: How does it feel to have written it to the end?

tour_yuna_9.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_9.text: It felt strange to call it the end.

tour_yuna_10.name: {name}
tour_yuna_10.text: *Yuna holds out the notebook. Its cover catches on the sofa fabric once, and she waits for my answer with one hand still gripping the corner.*

tour_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_freetalk.text: *She runs a finger along the book’s spine, then looks up.* I’ve talked a lot today, haven’t I?

tour_yuna_end.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_end.text: The first reader of the ending. I saved that place for you.

tour_dain_1.name: {name}
tour_dain_1.text: *The gym. Beside the line where we made our first bet stands the ball rack we filled last night. Today, the lights are on.*

tour_dain_1b.name: {name}
tour_dain_1b.text: *The gym. The lights are on today.*

tour_dain_2.name: Dain
tour_dain_2.text: *Dain stands in the middle of the court with a volleyball tucked against her side.*

tour_dain_3.name: Dain
tour_dain_3.text: Hey, one more round of rock-paper-scissors?

tour_dain_4.name: {name}
tour_dain_4.text: You're just going to lose again.

tour_dain_8.name: {name}
tour_dain_8.text: *Dain's brow furrows, but she can't keep the corners of her mouth from lifting. One beat late, she sets the volleyball on the court.*

tour_dain_10.name: Dain
tour_dain_10.text: I don't know about going pro yet.

tour_dain_11.name: {name}
tour_dain_11.text: *The ball rolls along the court line. I leave it alone until Dain speaks again.*

tour_dain_11_b.name: Dain
tour_dain_11_b.text: I used to think if volleyball was gone, I'd be empty too. Lately — it's not like that.

tour_dain_12.name: Dain
tour_dain_12.text: I don't know what changed. But now I have things I want to say off the court too.

tour_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
tour_dain_freetalk.text: *She stops a rolling volleyball under her shoe.* It’s the festival lunch break. We can’t call it a day yet.

tour_dain_end_2.name: {name}
tour_dain_end_2.text: *Dain's hand rests on the volleyball, not on her knee.*

tour_co_event_1.name: {name}
tour_co_event_1.text: *The lunch bell has rung, but the lines are short. All that remains in the hallway is the sound of lunchbox lids opening and closing.*

tour_co_event_2.name: {name}
tour_co_event_2.text: *An event vest hangs over the back of a chair. No one asks whose it is.*

tour_co_seo_1.name: {name}
tour_co_seo_1.text: *The rooftop door is open. Instead of heading for the railing, Seoyeon leans against the doorframe.*

tour_co_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_co_seo_2.text: I've returned the key. Let's leave it at that today.

tour_co_seo_3.name: {name}
tour_co_seo_3.text: *As Seoyeon turns away, the corner of her clipboard strikes the doorframe. She keeps walking.*

tour_co_yuna_1.name: {name}
tour_co_yuna_1.text: *On the sofa in the annex, Yuna winds her bag strap around one finger without opening her book.*

tour_co_yuna_2.name: Yuna
tour_co_yuna_2.text: I won't show you the ending today.

tour_co_yuna_3.name: {name}
tour_co_yuna_3.text: *Light slips through the window and spreads to the empty seat. Yuna stays where she is.*

tour_co_dain_1.name: {name}
tour_co_dain_1.text: *The gym lights are on, but all the balls are still in the rack.*

tour_co_dain_2.name: Dain
tour_co_dain_2.text: Rock-paper-scissors can wait till tomorrow. I want to rest today.

tour_co_dain_3.name: {name}
tour_co_dain_3.text: *Dain tugs the wrist wrap once and lets it go.*

tour_seo_event_1.name: Haeun
tour_seo_event_1.text: President, the broadcast club's rehearsal overlaps with the booth safety check. Should I cover the broadcast room?

tour_seo_event_2.name: {name}
tour_seo_event_2.text: *Seoyeon's hand moves toward the clipboard, then stops. She taps the box marked 'Broadcast' twice with her pen.*

tour_seo_event_3.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_event_3.text: Handle the broadcast room. Just tell me how it went when you're done.

tour_seo_event_4.name: Haeun
tour_seo_event_4.text: All right. But you can't come check on me halfway through.

tour_seo_event_5.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_event_5.text: *Haeun runs off. Seoyeon does not look back once.* Right. The festival won't fall apart just because one thing doesn't pass through my hands.

tour_yuna_event_1.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_1.text: *When we step into the annex hallway, two younger students are at the display board. They are reading Yuna's anonymous story and asking whether there is more.*

tour_yuna_event_2.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_2.text: *Yuna touches one corner of the page. Her hand, poised to pull it down, stops beneath the title.*

tour_yuna_event_3.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_event_3.text: There isn't a next part yet. But I wrote this.

tour_yuna_event_4.name: {name}
tour_yuna_event_4.text: *Yuna takes a pen from her pocket and writes beneath the title: 'Choi Yuna.' The letters lean slightly.*

tour_yuna_event_5.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_event_5.text: *She turns from the display and walks back into the annex.* You still get to see the ending first.

tour_dain_event_1.name: {name}
tour_dain_event_1.text: *The coach calls. Dain listens without interrupting as he asks whether she can play in the sports-day exhibition match.*

tour_dain_event_2.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_2.text: I'll sit this one out. I told Mom today too. But if the commentary booth is open, I can handle it.

tour_dain_event_3.name: {name}
tour_dain_event_3.text: *A little later, Dain taps the microphone in the booth. The entire court lies below us.*

tour_dain_event_4.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_4.text: Here comes the serve! That one was inside the line! I'll take complaints after the match!

tour_dain_event_5.name: Dain
tour_dain_event_5.text: *She switches off the microphone and catches her breath as we head down to the gym.* Turns out I still have plenty to say when I'm not the one playing. More than I thought.

tour_seo_affinity_80.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_affinity_80.text: I left the first slot in next week's schedule open. You pick the time.

tour_seo_affinity_60.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_affinity_60.text: Let's stop by the rooftop when we're done. I'll be the one waiting first today.

tour_yuna_affinity_80.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_affinity_80.text: Your seat is reserved as the first reader of the next story too. Let's write down a date when we're done.

tour_yuna_affinity_60.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_affinity_60.text: You read the last page I have to show today first.

tour_dain_affinity_80.name: Dain
tour_dain_affinity_80.text: Come when I practice commentary for the next game too. I'll send you the date.

tour_dain_affinity_60.name: Dain
tour_dain_affinity_60.text: Want to start with the broadcast booth? You're my first listener today.

tour_seo_neg.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_neg.text: *She doesn't take out the roof key.* Let's go separately today.

tour_yuna_neg.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_neg.text: *She locks the annex door.* Don't follow today.

tour_dain_neg.name: Dain
tour_dain_neg.text: *She turns off the gym lights.* Skip today. I'm going first.

day5_haeun_high_intro.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_high_intro.text: Could you take this side? Would you help me carry it to the broadcasting room? *Haeun holds out one end of a box of paperwork.*

day5_haeun_high_clasp.name: {name}
day5_haeun_high_clasp.text: *We set the box outside the broadcasting room. The clasp on Haeun’s student-council bracelet has caught on my sleeve button. She leans closer to free it. Footsteps in the hallway stop.*

day5_haeun_explain_choice.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_choice.text: *Haeun lets go of the bracelet and looks back. Standing between them, I begin to speak.*
choices: Introduce Haeun and explain what we were doing
Ask them to wait and put off explaining

day5_haeun_explain_open.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_open.text: *I introduce Haeun and explain that we were moving paperwork to the broadcasting room. She nods, but the other person is still looking at my sleeve.*

day5_haeun_explain_delay.name: {name}
day5_haeun_explain_delay.text: *I ask for a moment and turn back to Haeun, adding that I will explain later to the person waiting in the hallway.*

day5_haeun_defends.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_defends.text: I asked for help. I feel comfortable asking. *Haeun pulls the box closer.* We weren’t doing anything wrong.

day5_haeun_finish.name: {name}
day5_haeun_finish.text: *The broadcasting-room door opens and a student takes the box. Haeun fastens her bracelet. Announcements for the lunchtime events continue down the hallway.*

day5_haeun_low_intro.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_intro.text: Looking for the checklist? *Haeun draws the papers toward herself.* I’m not ready to leave this entirely to you.

day5_haeun_low_choice.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_choice.text: We just need to check the booth numbers and emergency access routes again. If you want to help, please come with me.
choices: Apologize for my earlier attitude and finish the inspection
Leave the task to Haeun and go

day5_haeun_low_apology.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_apology.text: *I apologize to Haeun for my earlier attitude and offer to finish the inspection with her. After a pause, she unfolds the checklist.* I hear your apology. Let’s start here, then.

day5_haeun_low_work.name: {name}
day5_haeun_low_work.text: *We check the booth numbers one by one, move empty boxes out of the passage and note where a sign is missing. I return the checklist to Haeun after checking the last entry.*

day5_haeun_low_repair.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_repair.text: *Haeun looks over the completed checklist.* You stayed until we finished. What happened before still bothers me, but thank you for helping today.

day5_haeun_low_thanks.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_thanks.text: *Haeun ticks the final box.* We finished early thanks to you. I’ll take the paperwork from here.

day5_haeun_low_leave.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_low_leave.text: All right. I’ll do the inspection. *Haeun folds the checklist and walks toward the booths.*

day5_haeun_seoyeon_arrival.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_arrival.text: So here you two are. *Seoyeon stops and looks from Haeun’s hand to my sleeve.* What were you doing?

day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation.text: So you’re close enough for her to ask freely. *Seoyeon turns toward me.* Tell me yourself. Since when have you two been this close?

day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation_delay.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_seoyeon_escalation_delay.text: So you’re close enough for her to ask freely. *Seoyeon turns toward me.* Tell me yourself. Since when have you two been this close?

day5_haeun_nurse_escalation.text: *The nurse stops smiling.* I’m not asking Haeun. I want to hear it from you. What’s between you two?

day5_haeun_concern_choice.name: {name}
day5_haeun_concern_choice.text: *Haeun turns toward me. The person listening to her stays where they are.*
choices: Ask what they heard and explain with Haeun present
Say I do not want to discuss it now

day5_haeun_concern_open.name: {name}
day5_haeun_concern_open.text: *I ask what they heard and say I will explain with Haeun here. The other person glances at her once more, then turns to me.*

day5_haeun_concern_delay.name: {name}
day5_haeun_concern_delay.text: *I say I don’t want to discuss it now and try to leave. The other person calls my name. Haeun stays as well.*

day5_haeun_concern_clarify.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_concern_clarify.text: I’m not trying to make you look bad by inventing things. I talked about what made me uncomfortable. *Haeun looks at me.* If I took it differently than you meant, please tell us here.

day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_intro.name: Haeun
day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_intro.text: *I hear Haeun around the corner. She is speaking quietly to someone, then stops when she sees me.* I felt uncomfortable when we talked before. I wasn’t sure how to take it, so I brought it up.

day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_arrival.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_arrival.text: What did you talk about with Haeun? *Seoyeon lowers her papers.* It didn’t sound like something I should brush aside.

day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_escalation.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_escalation.text: I want to know whether you realized she felt uncomfortable. *Seoyeon waits for my answer.* Tell us directly.

day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_escalation_de.name: Seoyeon
day5_haeun_concern_seoyeon_escalation_de.text: I want to know whether you realized she felt uncomfortable. *Seoyeon waits for my answer.* Tell us directly.
